# Research Artifact Rules

- Start with explicit research questions, scope, decision supported, method, and freshness cutoff.
- Give every decision-relevant finding an `INSIGHT-NNN` ID.
- Cite material external claims through `docs/project/source-register.md`; include URL, publisher, source type, published/updated date, access date, and confidence.
- Prefer current primary evidence and explain use of indirect, old, promotional, or disputed sources.
- Distinguish facts, inferences, assumptions, recommendations, conflicts, and unknowns.
- Do not convert market prevalence into a product requirement without project-specific evidence.
- Include limitations and actionable follow-up questions.
